title: Cruickshank's archival research into Kennedy records and MJ12

tellings.quote: like Jeff Krookshank have done a little bit have done like the forensic historical kind of uh deep dive look through the Kennedy archives

plain: A researcher named Jeff Cruickshank has dug through the Kennedy archives, the declassified records of President John F. Kennedy's time, looking for traces of MJ-12, a supposed secret top-level committee on UFOs named in a set of papers known as the MJ-12 documents. The researcher Matthew Pines brings up this "forensic historical" work in passing, as a way to test whether those papers line up with real government records.
